Name: Alternative Sam
Author: hiddlecutie
Description:
A Sam rework I made for myself but felt like sharing anyway !

[size=3]Always felt like someone who hangs out with the two emo kids in town wouldn't look like Sam (although there is nothing wrong with the vanilla version). [/size]

[size=2][u]Changes done[/u] :[/size]
Green and blue heterochromia, hair turned pink and minor changes in haircut, clothes turned black and red, no holes in the hoodie, septum piercing.

[u]Installation[/u] : 
Extract the archive. Just drop the contents in your Stardew Valley folder, SMAPI not required. 
If the main file is empty, try the alternative !
